assessments_validated_ck.name: assessments_validated_ck
assessments_validated_ck.value: NOT "assessments"."is_validated_instrument" OR ("assessments"."instrument_name" IS NOT NULL AND "assessments"."instrument_citation" IS NOT NULL)

assessments_demo_ck.name: assessments_demo_ck
assessments_demo_ck.value: "assessments"."is_demo" = ("assessments"."code" LIKE 'demo%') AND (NOT "assessments"."is_demo" OR ("assessments"."title" LIKE 'Demo:%' AND NOT "assessments"."is_validated_instrument"))

reference_maps_adjudicated_ck.name: reference_maps_adjudicated_ck
reference_maps_adjudicated_ck.value: "reference_maps"."status" = 'draft' OR ("reference_maps"."adjudicated_by" IS NOT NULL AND "reference_maps"."adjudicated_at" IS NOT NULL)

responses_answered_ck.name: responses_answered_ck
responses_answered_ck.value: "responses"."status" <> 'answered' OR ("responses"."raw" IS NOT NULL AND "responses"."answered_at" IS NOT NULL)

responses_order_ck.name: responses_order_ck
responses_order_ck.value: "responses"."answered_at" IS NULL OR "responses"."presented_at" IS NULL OR "responses"."answered_at" >= "responses"."presented_at"

sources_local_key_ck.name: sources_local_key_ck
sources_local_key_ck.value: "sources"."local_key" IS NULL OR "sources"."package_id" IS NOT NULL

traditions_demo_ck.name: traditions_demo_ck
traditions_demo_ck.value: "traditions"."is_demo" = ("traditions"."slug" LIKE 'demo%') AND (NOT "traditions"."is_demo" OR ("traditions"."name" LIKE 'Demo:%' AND "traditions"."verification_state" NOT IN ('verified', 'published')))

verification_records_actor_ck.name: verification_records_actor_ck
verification_records_actor_ck.value: "verification_records"."to_state" NOT IN ('verified', 'published') OR "verification_records"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL

content_snapshots_published_ck.name: content_snapshots_published_ck
content_snapshots_published_ck.value: "content_snapshots"."status" <> 'published' OR ("content_snapshots"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("content_snapshots"."published_by" IS NOT NULL OR "content_snapshots"."is_demo"))

manual_overrides_revoke_ck.name: manual_overrides_revoke_ck
manual_overrides_revoke_ck.value: ("manual_overrides"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("manual_overrides"."revoked_by" IS NULL) AND ("manual_overrides"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR "manual_overrides"."revoke_reason" IS NOT NULL)

spatial_manifests_published_ck.name: spatial_manifests_published_ck
spatial_manifests_published_ck.value: "spatial_manifests"."status" NOT IN ('published', 'superseded') OR "spatial_manifests"."published_at" IS NOT NULL

assets_dims_ck.name: assets_dims_ck
assets_dims_ck.value: ("assets"."width" IS NULL OR "assets"."width" > 0) AND ("assets"."height" IS NULL OR "assets"."height" > 0)

assets_alt_ck.name: assets_alt_ck
assets_alt_ck.value: "assets"."kind" NOT IN ('image', 'texture') OR "assets"."alt_text" IS NOT NULL

assets_accepted_licence_ck.name: assets_accepted_licence_ck
assets_accepted_licence_ck.value: "assets"."verification_state" NOT IN ('verified', 'published') OR "assets"."licence" IS NOT NULL

assets_demo_ck.name: assets_demo_ck
assets_demo_ck.value: NOT "assets"."is_demo" OR ("assets"."title" LIKE 'Demo:%' AND "assets"."provenance_kind" = 'unverified' AND "assets"."verification_state" NOT IN ('verified', 'published'))

media_candidates_dims_ck.name: media_candidates_dims_ck
media_candidates_dims_ck.value: ("media_candidates"."width" IS NULL OR "media_candidates"."width" > 0) AND ("media_candidates"."height" IS NULL OR "media_candidates"."height" > 0)

studies_active_ck.name: studies_active_ck
studies_active_ck.value: "studies"."status" = 'draft' OR ("studies"."snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL AND "studies"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)

study_sessions_excluded_ck.name: study_sessions_excluded_ck
study_sessions_excluded_ck.value: NOT "study_sessions"."excluded" OR ("study_sessions"."exclusion_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "study_sessions"."excluded_at" IS NOT NULL)

study_sessions_learning_clock_ck.name: study_sessions_learning_clock_ck
study_sessions_learning_clock_ck.value: ("study_sessions"."learning_ends_at" IS NULL OR "study_sessions"."learning_started_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("study_sessions"."learning_ended_at" IS NULL OR "study_sessions"."learning_ended_at" >= "study_sessions"."learning_started_at")
